tabs.title: Relay
tabs.purpose: Infrastructure, release operations and incident follow-up

rows.text: Morning. The heater is making that ticking sound again. I think it does that when it starts up.
I'm looking out at the courtyard. The pavement still has that wet stripe where the sun hasn't reached.
Send Relay a reminder to rotate the staging logs before noon.

routes.payload: Rotate the staging logs before noon.

rows.text: Hang on, I need a different cable. This one never stays seated.
Put this into the standup document as two bullets: the invoice import is complete, and the receipts export is blocked on sample data.

patch.heading: Standup
bullets: Receipts export is blocked on sample data.

rows.text: I keep picking the mug up and forgetting to drink. It's a little too hot still.
What was that noise? Oh, it's the upstairs door. Nothing going on down here.
Send QA a request to check keyboard focus on the export dialog, and tell Canvas the button label should read Download receipts.

routes.payload: Check keyboard focus on the export dialog.
Change the button label to Download receipts.

rows.text: That espresso is stronger than usual. I may have grabbed the wrong bag.
For Canvas, about the spacing around the confirmation card, could you—
Wait, here's the screenshot.
Screenshot dropped
Ask them to add eight pixels of padding on each side of that card and include the screenshot.

routes.payload: Add eight pixels of padding to each side of the confirmation card. See shot-confirmation.

rows.text: The radiator has gone quiet. I can hear somebody moving chairs now.
Please tell Relay to keep the temporary backup until Friday's validation is complete.

routes.payload: Keep the temporary backup until Friday's validation is complete.

rows.text: It smells like rain again. Maybe somebody opened the downstairs window.
Add that there too — to Notes, please. I mean the same instruction I just sent to Relay.

routes.payload: Keep the temporary backup until Friday's validation is complete.

rows.text: Remember that the staging rehearsal is always scheduled on Thursday mornings.

turns.fact: The staging rehearsal is always scheduled on Thursday mornings.

rows.text: The neighbor's dog is making the rounds again. It's very determined about that one tree.
Add a paragraph to the standup document: the sample receipts arrived, so the export check can resume as soon as the reviewer has time.

patch.heading: Standup
patch.prose: The sample receipts arrived. The export check can resume when the reviewer is available.

rows.text: That's the wrong playlist. I had something quieter on a few minutes ago.
Send QA a request to validate CSV headers against the April template, especially the tax amount column.

routes.payload: Validate CSV headers against the April template, especially the tax amount column.

rows.text: Add that there too. By there I mean Notes, so they can see the QA request.

routes.payload: Validate CSV headers against the April template, especially the tax amount column.

rows.text: The charging light just blinked twice. I think the cable is finally sitting properly.
For the incident notes, make a new Follow-up section with a bullet to check the certificate expiry after deployment.
No, the umbrella's probably still in the hall. I haven't been outside since lunch.
Let Relay know that the sandbox refresh can begin after the load test finishes.

routes.payload: Begin the sandbox refresh after the load test finishes.

rows.text: One of the desk drawers is sticking. It was doing the same thing yesterday.
I'm reading the weather forecast. It says sunny, but the sky looks gray all the way across.
Ask Canvas to compare the new empty state with the previous version before the review.

routes.payload: Compare the new empty state with the previous version before the review.

rows.text: Put the export issue somewhere sensible, I was thinking—
One second, the export capture is still loading.
Screenshot dropped
The window over here is finally open. There's a breeze now.
Right, send QA that screenshot and ask them to reproduce the export dialog freeze when clicking Cancel twice.

routes.payload: Reproduce the export dialog freeze when clicking Cancel twice. See shot-export.

rows.text: The other chair is much lower than I remember. Everything feels a little off when I sit in it.
Tell Notes the trial review moved to Tuesday at ten, and tell Relay that the performance sample is ready for inspection.

routes.payload: The trial review moved to Tuesday at ten.
The performance sample is ready for inspection.

rows.text: The desk lamp is showing dust I didn't notice before. I can deal with it this weekend.
Add a final bullet under Follow-up in the document: verify the accessibility checklist before the handoff.

patch.heading: Follow-up
bullets: Verify the accessibility checklist before handoff.

rows.text: There's the bell from across the street. Must be close to the hour again.
